# 05_Premiere-Assets (yellow style)

Things to drop onto a Premiere Pro timeline: corner bug, lower thirds and overlay loops. Read PREMIERE-README.md first.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`corner-bug/`](corner-bug/) | The logo as a watermark: PNGs at 512, 256 and 128 px (light and colour), the 150 x 150 YouTube watermark, and a 10 s transparent clip that fades in, sits at 70 % and fades out. |
| [`lower-thirds/`](lower-thirds/) | Three lower-third designs, 5 s each, transparent (ProRes 4444 .mov), plus a still of each. |
| [`overlays/`](overlays/) | 4K, 10 s seamless loops to lay over footage: film grain (fine, medium, coarse) and dust and scratches (grey: blend mode Overlay / Screen), and soft light leaks in this style's colours (blend mode Screen). |
